terms.comment: Modern, formed like metrum (see metre) and chīliometrum. The vowel of metrum is common in Lewis & Short and is left unmarked.

phrases.latin: Hic baculus trīgintā centimetra longus est.
phrases.english: This stick is thirty centimetres long.

phrases.latin: Ad postem tē mētiāmur: quīnque centimetrīs major es quam aestāte.
phrases.english: Let’s measure you against the doorpost: you’re five centimetres taller than in the summer.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. metric length: centimeter.
